exceptions.rationale: ESLint 9 remains required because eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y supplies Astro's reviewed static accessibility rules. Its published peer range has no supported ESLint 10 release under this workspace's strict peer-dependency policy.
exceptions.compensatingControls: The affected dependency is development-only lint tooling; the raw pnpm audit command remains available; this validator fails closed unless the advisory, severity, package, version, and complete path set match exactly.
exceptions.removalTrigger: Remove this exception when a supported eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y release accepts ESLint 10 and the lint toolchain can be upgraded without relaxing strict peer dependencies or reducing React and Astro accessibility coverage.
